grouping: All source fault classes, severities and artificial perturbations for a date stay in the same split. No random window split.
public_demos: Existing BDG2, normal SDAHU and duplicate-corrupted SDAHU demos retained; never counted as final evaluation.
scope: Same simulated SDAHU system, new-date temporal holdout only. Neither cross-equipment nor real-building fault validation.
final_access_rule: Preparation process may serialize and seal; no diagnostic development reads or summarizes final sensor values or labels. After all code/thresholds/metrics frozen, evaluation writes predictions before labels are read.
